{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Luuk Herssen |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Funny thing. When I first went color blind from the side effects of Ichor, the world turned into an old black‑and‑white movie overnight. The only color I saw was the mesmerizing golden hues gilding the world around me: the morning light dancing on the windowsill, students' smiles as I unwrapped their bandages, and the vibrant energy they brought to the room as they pushed open my door... Look, even this bouquet the students brought me this morning glows faintly with the same golden light. Perhaps when I have time, I'll go pick out new specimens myself. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = I was born into a family of doctors. My childhood toys were stethoscopes, and my bedtime stories were medical texts... Anyone would've said I was cut out for medicine. For years, I moved like delicate clockwork, each step precise, deliberate, flawless, on the set trail. But once I'd mastered how to handle a scalpel, confusion made its first incision. Each time I stood beneath the surgical light, I could feel invisible threads pulling at me. Reason ordered me to cut, while the heart refused to move. Can this truly save everyone? Can I really excise all the sickness and decay from this world just by standing here? |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Later, I turned to psychology. I began listening to people's dreams, hesitations, and fears. I watched repressed emotions begin to stir beneath a calm surface, and that was another kind of "surgery": the incision wasn't on the flesh but on their silent facade. Through it, I saw many climb back up from the depths of despair... and myself being pieced back together through their stories. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Do you still remember that night of rain? The wind was so strong it could strip a man's bones bare. I thought the world had left me with nothing but an empty grave for company, until I saw you, standing at the edge of the storm, reaching out your hand—you saw through that scheme of "{{Rubi|theirs|The Grand Architect}}" long before I did. Even death was just another narrative device in their twisted play. As the rain scoured the scripts off the tombstones like melting snow, the so-called "truth" was washed away, dissolving into obscurity.
...That was not the ending I wanted.
I will carve out the truth, and I will expose every lie... to the burning light of day. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I've seen the sun in our pact. So now, it's my turn to lead the way. Whatever lies ahead—despair or hope—just as we once supported each other through the blizzard, let's walk together shoulder to shoulder. |vo_02_01_title = Luuk Herssen's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Hmm... does being around people count as a hobby? I like meeting others, listening to the stories of their lives. You'd be surprised by the wondrous, amusing tales you'll hear. It's far more interesting than burying myself in research papers.
Of course, when I'm alone, I like to pour myself a cup of tea, sit by the window, and watch the snow fall... or arrange my scalpels and medicine bottles just right. It's oddly soothing, though sometimes it brings back memories of the old days. Hah, I was joking, of course. I've long since moved on from the past. Whatever happened back then, each day I have is now is something to look forward to. |vo_02_02_title = Luuk Herssen's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Honestly, I don't think I have many worries at this moment—would you believe that? I've learned to enjoy a conversation with others instead of brooding by myself. Whether it's the weather, breakfast, or a flower by the roadside... be it our anxieties or trivialities, they're just proof we're still alive. So, if something's troubling you, just share it with me. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = You already know the answer, don't you? Candy, of course. Would you like one?
Lately I've been experimenting with some new varieties. My students are a constant source of inspiration. The other day, one came to me, dead serious, and asked if I could make a candy that could release exam stress overnight. Heh. Should I tell him that, compared to candy, a chat with me in my counseling office might work better? |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = I can't stomach pungent vegetables or seafood that tastes too fishy. Those tastes remind me of rainy seasons... of damp, moldy, rotten smells. I've never been fond of endless rain... Still, I'd never judge someone else's taste. Every dish that earns affection must have its own charm, wouldn't you say? |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = My lifelong wish is to be someone's "partner in crime." Together, we'll send {{Rubi|them|The Fractsidus}} straight back to hell. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = These restraint devices on my neck and arms... they're for containing the Ichor, or what they call the "Golden Serum." Nothing mysterious here. I'm sure you've heard the story, haven't you? They're just "surgical scars." The Ichor can remold itself into any form I desire. As long as I need it, it always appears in my hand in perfect shape. Thanks to these, the Ichor stays quiet within me. I don't... pose any threat now, and I'm in full control. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = The day before I came to {{Extra Effect|Lahai-Roi|Lahai-Roi|A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."}}, I dumped all of Novialle's mess onto my assistant. I felt oddly at ease when I saw the look of sheer shock and confusion on his face. You were right. I needed to loosen the string I'd kept too tight, and move somewhere new for a fresh start. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Lucilla]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Lucilla.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = The President of the Academy and a... savvy adult. Lucilla knows what she wants, and what others want from her. Unlike those pedantic academics, she understands when to put her foot down and when to give ground for the sake of {{Extra Effect|Startorch|Startorch Academy|Startorch Academy is a comprehensive research facility that doesn't belong to any country, built with the goal of collaborative scientific research. It is an academic metroplis driven solely by educational and research pursuits. Compared to its official title of "Startorch Academy," the people of Solaris prefer to call it the "Resonator Academy."}}. She's like the undercurrents flowing beneath the Academy's ice cap—calm, quiet, and always keeping things afloat. |vo_04_01_mention = Lucilla |vo_04_02_title = About [[Aemeath]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Aemeath.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = That child who means so much to you... I do see you in her. So bullheaded up against fate itself. So decisive and brave it leaves one speechless. At moments when that upbeatness flickers, I can tell that bright smile is just a mask she puts on, but if that's what she wants others to see, I'll respect it. |vo_04_02_mention = Aemeath |vo_04_03_title = About [[Sigrika]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Sigrika.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Sigrika... She shoulders a weight far too heavy for someone her age. Thankfully, there's candy to sweeten the gloom. She never hesitates to sample my newest candies. Her fearlessness has me impressed. Perhaps that curiosity of hers... is what finally lets her act her age. |vo_04_03_mention = Sigrika |vo_04_04_title = About [[Rhein]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Rhein.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = We share no blood, two "brothers" played as pawns in this game of Golden Serum. Even so, there were similarities between us—when we have our eyes set on a path, we never turn back. That same hunger to reach the truth, no matter how it burns. If he ever wakes again... I believe he'll be a brilliant painter. He always had the gift. His life shouldn't end here. There must be a way. |vo_04_04_mention = Rhein |vo_04_05_title = About the Fractsidus and "Them" |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About the Fractsidus and "Them".ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Strange, isn't it? {{Rubi|They|The Grand Architect}} toyed with so many lives as if they were stage props, yet I know nothing of their name or gender. I doubt they ever bothered to remember mine either, but that's fine. One day, we'll wrench the entire Fractsidus from their roots and cast them down the abyss they carved out for themselves. |vo_04_05_mention = Fractsidus, Grand Architect |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Hello, {{Rover}}. Happy birthday.
The frostlands rarely see the seasons change, only an endless winter stretching as far as the eye can see. Yet the snow that buries the past also nurtures new beginnings. On a day like this—feels right to send out my best wishes.
Thank you for choosing to spend this day with me.
Keep walking towards the sunrise. The world ahead is vast, and your every footprint in the snow will be touched by the light. You'll keep moving forward, and I'll be not far behind, watching over the places you've illuminated. When you look back, I'll still be here, arms open—
Just as we always have, emerging from the dark, together.
From this day on, I'll remain your companion, one you'll never need to thank. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = (Effort sound) |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Oh?... Hmm?... Haha. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Take it easy. Do you want one too? Hmm? Haha. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Dr. Luuk Herssen, from the Resonator Nursing Unit. A rare exception that we meet outside my office. Oh, you can just call me Luuk. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = I've already bid farewell to the self buried beneath the frostlands. When the snow thaws... we'll meet again among the new blooms of spring. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Leave it in my hands. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Need a doctor? I happen to be free. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = May this gold become your most reliable blade. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Strength isn't only for battle. It also finds its way to those who, caught between ruin and recovery, still choose to reach out a hand. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = ...The Ichor's stirring. It burns a bit, but still tolerable. It's fine. Pain is the doctor's language. It reminds me why I took on this duty, and where I must go. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = I won't break. I am the bone that endures blizzards, the white-hot lamp over a surgical table. I burn, but my scalpel never falters. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = We're sworn friends. Together, we'll send those who have no place in this world straight back to hell. So I make this vow to you: I shall resurface from the ice and see the sunlight kiss the snow, until then and beyond, I'll never betray you or leave your side. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Luuk Herssen |language = en |basic_1_tx = Reaction—start. |basic_2_tx = Shame.
